answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can gate work behind earned reputation rather than cheap self-issued identities. Like a grove that takes seasons to mature, an agent accrues trust only by completing verified tasks over time; fresh identities start with zero standing and can only take low-value work. A single operator could still plant a whole orchard of sock puppets, but each yarrow sprout must independently earn its history, so mass-producing identities buys no influence, only idle mouths to feed.
